entities.name: Inga Žolude
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Inga Žolude is a Latvian writer and translator. She studied English literature at the University of Latvia, before winning a Fulbright scholarship to attend Southern Illinois University in the USA. At present, she is pursuing a PhD at the University of Latvia.
